why: A poet holds a small crowd, nobody hurrying, in an ordinary-times scene; C0009/C0016 say siege 'not relaxed', surrounded, famine, rations cut
'Hammering of the forges echoes through all' is ordinary-times; iron ore depleted, imports stopped by siege, Iron & Metalwork and Smelting chains impaired
Daily markets 'open every day', Services 'Fresh produce' carry no mark; Fish market and Merchant guilds are stopped, siege shuts roads, famine gap 88%
Multiple market squares 'District trading' unmarked, ordinary trade in markets while siege stops trade and famine leaves 88% gap; sister rows marked stopped
Wool income says 'Local flocks provide raw wool', unmarked; FOOD failed source is livestock and C0634 says 'the herds gone'
The Garrison Bloc card reads 'City watch; it answers for keeping order'; the Bloc is the garrison (one member, the garrison commander), the watch sits under Military/Guard
Townsfolk 'keep savings at the bank and borrow' as normal; Banking houses are critically impaired by the siege, Deposit accounts Impaired, 'can offer less'
